_comment: Rule-to-fixture mappings that example-files/README.md does not state itself. Its spatial-problems, empty-layer and attribute-problems tables carry an explicit 'Error code' column and are parsed directly; invalid-schema and malformed do not, so those are recorded here. Paths are relative to example-files/ and are verified to exist on every run. Add a mapping only where the fixture's condition maps unambiguously to one rule — a guess here is worse than an honest 'no fixture'.
GPKG_MISSING_LAYER: invalid-schema/Baseline - no habitats table, three rlb polygons.gpkg
GPKG_BASELINE_MISSING_COLUMN: invalid-schema/Baseline - wrong column names in Habitats.gpkg
invalid-schema/Baseline - missing and wrong column names in Habitats.gpkg
GPKG_BASELINE_COLUMN_SQLITE_TYPE: invalid-schema/Baseline - wrong column data types in Habitats.gpkg
GPKG_BASELINE_GEOMETRY_TYPE_NAME: invalid-schema/Baseline - wrong geometry type in Habitats.gpkg
invalid-schema/Baseline - wrong geometry type in Hedgerows.gpkg
invalid-schema/Baseline - wrong geometry type in Rivers.gpkg
invalid-schema/Post-intervention - wrong geometry type in RLB layer.gpkg
GPKG_BASELINE_SRS_ID: invalid-schema/Baseline - rlb has wrong spatial reference.gpkg
GPKG_BASELINE_MULTIPLE_GEOMETRY_COLUMNS: invalid-schema/Post-intervention - multiple geometry columns in RLB layer.gpkg
GPKG_RLB_NO_GEOMETRY_COLUMN: invalid-schema/Post-intervention - no geometry column in RLB layer.gpkg
GPKG_RLB_TOO_MANY_POLYGONS: invalid-schema/Baseline - no habitats table, three rlb polygons.gpkg
